# Country releases installed with the Core checkout for the smoke tests,
# resolved together so that no later install replaces the Core under test.
# These country releases declare support for Python 3.11-3.14;
# neither a --no-deps workaround nor policyengine-us-data is required.
# Pinned exactly so that CI is reproducible. Old policyengine-us releases are
# deleted from PyPI as space is needed (1.824.1, pinned here until October
# 2026, was), so move the US pin to a current release when it stops resolving.
# US 2.42.13 requires spm-calculator>=1.0.0,<=1.0.0.post1; the SPM pin is the
# release it resolves to.
policyengine-us==2.42.13
policyengine-uk==2.90.2
spm-calculator==1.0.0.post1
